settings.data_dir.description: Override Handy's data directory (history.db, logs, recordings). Leave empty for the default location.
settings.refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval
settings.refresh_seconds.description: How often the service checks Handy's state and history, in seconds.
settings.model_refresh_seconds.label: Model refresh interval
settings.model_refresh_seconds.descripti: How often the downloaded-model list is read from Handy's tray menu, in seconds.

settings.history_limit.description: Maximum number of transcripts listed in the panel.
settings.transcript_lines.label: Transcript preview lines
settings.transcript_lines.description: How many lines of each transcript to show before clicking to copy it.
settings.show_state_text.label: Show state text
settings.show_state_text.description: Show REC / … / OFF next to the bar icon instead of only changing the glyph.
